verdict.rationale: Linear's first-party changelog documents creating documents from team home pages, attaching existing documents to projects and issues, and grouping resources into sections. Document creation and editing also work on iOS and Android, documents support callout components, and Loops can keep docs and project descriptions current. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the docs workflow, and explicit evidence on real-time co-editing and document-level sharing permissions.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work

citations.quote: Teams can create documents directly from their home page, add existing documents from projects and issues, and group resources into sections.
Document creation and editing are now available in Linear's iOS and Android apps.
Use callout components to draw attention to important information in issue and project descriptions, as well as documents.
use Loops to keep docs and project descriptions up-to-date
